Sentinel is a distributed real-time vision system framework for local area networks (LAN) that repurposes unused Android devices as network camera nodes. It enables distributed image acquisition, real-time PC-side video streaming, and AI-driven monitoring and analysis, supporting local video recording and structured event output.
